test_title: PYST 9: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 14th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Convert from passive to active:“The documents are believed to have been leaked by insiders.”

options.text: It is believed that insiders leaked the documents.
The insiders are believed to have leaked the documents.
The leak allegedly exposed the documents.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Active voice structure: The subject of the passive voice sentence becomes the agent or doer of the action in the active voice.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The documents are believed to have been leaked by insiders."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the agent "the insiders" at the beginning.
 
• Use the structure "are believed to have leaked" for the active construction.
 
• This maintains the same meaning as the original sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"The insiders are believed to have leaked the documents."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"It is believed that insiders leaked the documents." – This changes the structure and introduces a dummy subject "it."
 
• **Option 2: **"Insiders allegedly leaked the documents." – The word "allegedly" is not in the original sentence and changes the nuance.
 
• **Option 4: **"The leak allegedly exposed the documents." – This changes both the subject and the meaning.
